name: The Santa Maria Hotel & Golf Resort
positioning: The Santa Maria, a Luxury Collection Hotel & Golf Resort: a city golf resort in Panama City built around a Jack Nicklaus-designed championship course, minutes from the airport and downtown
best_for: Golfers who want a championship course at their hotel in Panama City
Travelers who want a resort base close to Panama Viejo and Costa del Este

facts.text: The resort is located minutes from Tocumen International Airport and downtown Panama City, with easy access to Panama Viejo and Costa del Este.
The centerpiece of the resort is a championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
The golf course is an 18-hole, par-72 layout with rippling fairways and sculpted bunkers that challenge both scratch handicappers and novice golfers.
The golf club offers rental equipment, professional lessons and a driving range, and the course has four tee box locations to suit players of all ages and skill levels.
The decor is accented by handmade artifacts from Reprosa's Treasure of Panama, a company dedicated to preserving the country's history and cultural traditions.
The Master Suite and the Grand Suite each have a dining room, a guest bathroom and a living room.
Room bathrooms are marble, with double vanities and lighted mirrors.
Spa treatments include an array of massage, facial and body scrub options.
Complimentary poolside cabanas are reserved for hotel guests.
Mestizo serves Panamanian cuisine with Mediterranean flair, and The Grill offers steak and seafood.
Mestizo Bar is surrounded by artwork from local artists.
The concierge can arrange tours of the Panama Viejo ruins or trips to Casco Viejo.

highlights.text: The centerpiece of the resort is a championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
Executive Suites feature Panamanian design elements: Mola bed runners inspired by Guna Yala, handmade baskets by the indigenous Embera community and wood sourced from Gatun Lake.
The Master Suite is on the 7th floor and has a private terrace with golf course views.
The pool looks out over the 18-hole course and cosmopolitan Panama City.
The spa's Espiritu Santo Signature Massage is inspired by the Flor del Espiritu Santo, Panama's national flower.

considerations.text: The resort is a city base minutes from the airport and downtown; the concierge can arrange a day trip to a sandy beach or a rainforest.
Golf tee times are not offered on Mondays.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
